data.exact_reserve_text: Adjustments to the amounts of the claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the technical account for the period in which the adjustments are made.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Loss portfolio reinsurance contracts entered into in 2018 impacted 2020 and prior years of account.
Loss portfolio reinsurance contracts entered into in 2021 impacted 2020 and prior years of account.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2023 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at the start of the year (the prior year closing balance) was 5,426.0 (USD millions). The claims development triangle and reserves analysis show effectively no net prior year development for older years (net movement approximately zero), i.e. prior year reserves were broadly stable. The reserving process considered inflationary pressures and elevated catastrophe activity, and earlier years were noted to be impacted by loss portfolio reinsurance transactions (Riverstone). No specific gross prior-year strengthening or release amount is stated in the notes, and the claims development table shows negligible net movement across the older underwriting years.
raw_causal_phrases: Movement in these reserves forms an integral element of the operating result.

As part of the year-end reserving exercise, the impact of inflation was considered in detail by the Actuarial team to ensure that assumptions are consistent with forward looking expectations for claims inflation.
The market has continued to experience a level of catastrophe activity significantly in excess of historical levels.

The 2020 and prior years of account have been impacted by the loss portfolio reinsurance contracts entered into in the 2018 and 2021 calendar years with Riverstone Managing Agency Limited (for and on behalf of Lloyd's Syndicate 3500
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) gross figure not explicitly stated in a single 'movement in prior years' gross column. PYD is derived from the gross claims development triangle (page 45) comparing the current estimates to the prior diagonal for underwriting years up to 2020, which results in a net movement of approximately zero. The triangle excludes an aggregated '2013 & prior' column (excluded from PYD calculation) and the two most recent underwriting years per methodology. There is a note that 2020 and prior years were impacted by loss portfolio reinsurance contracts (Riverstone), which can distort development; this has been noted but no quantified gross impact is disclosed. All monetary amounts are in US dollars (report's functional currency).
